main_measure.name: t of the mean across days of the |forecast|/10-weighted short-direction unusual 5-bar move

statistic.name: t of the mean across days

main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with slope > 0; reject t <= -2; at least 30 distinct case days

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short-direction unusual 5-bar move on |forecast|

reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping 5-bar grid of all its windows, the slope is unweighted over all cases, a case day is the UTC date of the case bar, and the volume regime is recomputed from volume where a window holds 118 bars, else read from the recorded regime.
